en: Multi-view postcard showing a modernist seaside hotel complex called Hotel Ambassador. The top-left image shows a low, wide, terraced hotel building with balconies; the top-right image shows a crowded sandy beach with sunbathers and parasols by the sea; the bottom images show the hotel's interior lounge and dining room with red ceilings, pendant lights, and neatly arranged tables. In the center is a red ribbon banner with the hotel name written in Cyrillic script.
